Cyclic parity gives max floor((n-1)/2) with 2n maximizers. Standard longest-run union and disjoint-block probability bounds prove T/log2 n ->1/2. Independent exhaustive simulation n3..10 reproduced all first-entry layers (n10: 124,590,230,60,20).
